subject: Phone harness and neck clamp, a view
status: Technical concept illustration; not dimensioned or mechanically validated
neck_geometry: The stock silver neck is a rectangular prism with a square cross-section, flat faces, and sharp longitudinal edges; the orange split phone clamp grips its square profile, not a cylinder.
color_key: All added 3D-printed clamp, harness, cable-guide, and lever parts are orange. The stock blue center brace and blue handle are outside this crop. Stock metal remains silver and claw feet black.

axes.y: up, parallel to the long reacher neck
axes.z: out of the page toward the viewer; negative z goes into the page

requirements: One close view of the phone, its harness, and the neck below the claw fork; no inset or additional view.
A removable split 3D-printed clamp grips the fluted reacher neck without drilling or using the claw mechanism.
A GoPro-like open-corner harness secures the phone against sliding out, while leaving all rear camera lenses uncovered.
The phone lies in a plane perpendicular to the neck with rear cameras facing the claws; this a view looks toward its short bottom edge and charging port.

Move the phone to positive x and negative z relative to the neck so its near thin long side face, perpendicular to the broad camera face, rests against the neck-mounted support. Maintain the same orientation and visible charging-port edge.
The charging port is visible but unused by the actuation mechanism.

A bicycle brake cable outer housing stops at the mount, and its pulled inner wire pivots a compact lever against one side volume rocker. Show the housing stop, wire attachment, pivot, and contact point as a continuous physical path.
Keep phone and mechanism outside the moving claw sweep and show a small x/y/z axis glyph on opaque white technical drawing paper, with positive z toward the viewer.

subsequent_measured_cad_constraints.neck: Measured rectangular section: 14 mm project X, 19 mm project Z. Supersedes square assumption; original image preserved.
subsequent_measured_cad_constraints.carrier: One adjustable opposing padded-jaw carrier for bare/cased phones, including 18 mm wallet case; no GoPro interface.
subsequent_measured_cad_constraints.actuation: Adjustable volume-up contact held during squeeze; spring accommodation for excess travel; compact 3a housing anchor and flexible trigger strap.
subsequent_measured_cad_constraints.status: Historical illustration unchanged; consult source/ and print/ for R3 CAD geometry.
